notes.title: Quick mode and Ghost | New 1.1 Patch
notes.content:
Welcome back time travelers, we've got some news for you. 

We're happy to announce you our Patch 1.1. 

This patch will bring two new features and some various bug fixes. 

The new features will be available in the Settings menu and are called Fast movement and Preview next turn. This is essentially a quality of life improvement. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42035039/276db990652180e8e0f24f2c652aa2151f30b5ea.jpg


Fast movement is self-explanatory: this option will speed up a lot of animations and allow you to go through the levels much more quickly. 

 Preview next turn will be activated by default for new users. This option will add a ghost trail of the next recorded move.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42035039/b1eb8361fc2eb65d162956b53bc0fd0c1715da95.gif


If you experience any issues or want to give feedback, please join the official Pandaroo Interactive Discord : https://discord.gg/xNwmsgxk or use the community hub.

Thanks,

The Pandaroo Interactive Team
